# Emboss

Presses the image into a relief lit from one side: edges facing the light rise, the others sink.

<EffectDemo effect="emboss" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { emboss } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/emboss';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(emboss({ preset: 'metal' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.angle = 135`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter  | Type    | Default | Range      | Description                               |
| ---------- | ------- | ------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `angle`    | number  | `135`   | 0 – 360 °  | Direction the light comes from.           |
| `strength` | number  | `2`     | 0 – 8      | Height of the relief.                     |
| `distance` | number  | `1`     | 0.5 – 4 px | How wide the raised edges are.            |
| `colored`  | boolean | `false` |            | Keep the image’s colors under the relief. |
| `amount`   | number  | `1`     | 0 – 1      | Mix between the original and the relief.  |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                         |
| --------- | -------------------------------- |
| `metal`   | `strength: 3`, `distance: 1.5`   |
| `colored` | `colored: true`, `strength: 1.5` |
| `deep`    | `strength: 6`, `distance: 2.5`   |
| `subtle`  | `colored: true`, `strength: 0.8` |

Apply one with `emboss({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Stylization · tracked as story X8.11 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 0.0 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 6.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/emboss`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Related

- [Toon posterize](./posterize) — Flattens brightness into a few bands while keeping each color’s hue, and darkens edges, for a cartoon look on any image.
